# TPC-Havoc Q16_v5

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
with excluded_suppliers as (
    select
        s_suppkey
    from
        supplier
    where
        s_comment like '%Customer%Complaints%'
),
filtered_parts as (
    select
        p_partkey,
        p_brand,
        p_type,
        p_size
    from
        part
    where
        p_brand <> 'Brand#45'
        and p_type not like 'MEDIUM POLISHED%'
        and p_size in (49, 14, 23, 45, 19, 3, 36, 9)
),
valid_partsupp as (
    select
        fp.p_brand,
        fp.p_type,
        fp.p_size,
        ps.ps_suppkey
    from
        filtered_parts fp
        inner join partsupp ps on fp.p_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
        left join excluded_suppliers es on ps.ps_suppkey = es.s_suppkey
    where
        es.s_suppkey is null
)
select
    p_brand,
    p_type,
    p_size,
    count(distinct ps_suppkey) as supplier_cnt
from
    valid_partsupp
group by
    p_brand,
    p_type,
    p_size
order by
    supplier_cnt desc,
    p_brand,
    p_type,
    p_size
```
